title: Export follows the Category filter and the Supply filter
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPFLT-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered), with Min 5, Max 10 and quantity 1.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPFLT-02) is active and tracked, in category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered), with Min 5, Max 10 and quantity 1.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPFLT-03) is active and untracked, in {Category-A}, with quantity 1 in its bin.
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXPFLT).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-A}.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Export.
  6. Open the downloaded file and look for {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C}.
  7. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  8. Open the Supply filter and pick Under-supplied.
  9. Write down which of {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} the list shows.
  10. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  11. Click Export.
  12. Open the second downloaded file and look for {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The list shows {Part-A} and {Part-C}, and not {Part-B}.
  • Step 6: The file holds exactly {Part-A} and {Part-C}, the two parts the Category filter leaves, and not {Part-B}.
  • Step 9: {Part-C} is not listed: an untracked part shows only under All in the Supply filter.
  • Step 12: The file holds exactly the parts you wrote down in Step 9 and no other part. {Part-C} is not in it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-R9b, S6-R10, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.1 (The actions menu), board 3.5 (The Inactive tab), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 4). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R9b: “The export includes every part on that tab that matches the current search, filters and Supply filter, including parts not yet scrolled into view. With nothing matching, the message "Empty export" shows and no file is made.”
  • S6-R10: “In the Supply filter, an untracked part shows only under "All". Under-supplied, Well-supplied and Over-supplied leave it out.”
